summary: Fixed two critical issues: (1) MODULE_NOT_FOUND error causing 'Invoke Claude All' to fail - the require() call for profile-utils was causing bundling issues, fixed by using the already imported function. (2) False 100% usage alert for ZAI - the alert was showing MCP tools quota (TIME_LIMIT: 100%) instead of actual token usage (TOKENS_LIMIT: 60%). For ZAI, now always prioritize sessionPercent (token usage) over weeklyPercent (tools quota) for the limitType calculation.
current_status: Both issues fixed. User needs to rebuild the app for changes to take effect. After rebuild: (1) 'Invoke Claude All' should work without MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors, (2) Usage alert should show 60% (token usage) instead of 100% (tools quota).
next_steps: User needs to rebuild and restart the app: npm run dev
